meta.title: DeepSeek Remote
meta.description: End-to-end encrypted remote access to DeepSeek Harness and Codex workspaces from desktop, web, and Android.

en.accountHint: The account must belong to the selected Server.
en.authorizeFromRemote: Sign in from the Remote entry in the sidebar, then return here to manage this device.
en.clientSignInHint: Sign in to this Server to list your remote Hosts.
en.codexRemoteHint: Connect to CodeX projects on this Host.
en.codexSaved: Codex Remote setting saved. Restart DSH to apply it.
en.connectionAuthorizationExpired: Authorization expired. Sign out and authorize this Host again.
en.connectionCredentialsBusy: Credential refresh is locked. Stop other instances. After a crash, stop all instances before removing server-credentials.json.refresh-lock and authorizing again.
en.connectionDeviceRevoked: This Host was revoked on the Server. Sign out and authorize it again.
en.connectionInvalidResponse: The Server returned an invalid control message.
en.connectionOwnershipRequired: The Server no longer recognizes this Host as an owned device.
en.connectionRateLimited: The Server is receiving too many requests. Automatic retry will continue.
en.connectionReachability: Cannot reach the Server. Check the network and Server address.
en.connectionReplaced: Another instance is using this Host identity. Stop it or use a separate DSH_HOME before reconnecting.
en.connectionRouteEncrypted: Application data remains end-to-end encrypted along this route.
en.connectionRouteLanDetail: Direct transfer over the local network
en.connectionRouteRelayDetail: Encrypted transfer through the Remote Server
en.connectionRouteTurnDetail: Encrypted transfer through the TURN service
en.connectionUnexpected: The connection stopped unexpectedly. Automatic retry will continue.
en.connectionVersionMismatch: The Plugin and Server protocol versions are incompatible.
en.cursorRemoteHint: Enable the Cursor `agent acp` backend for the Agent ACP gateway. Requires local `agent login`. Restart DSH after changing this setting.
en.cursorSaved: Cursor ACP adapter setting saved. Restart DSH to apply it.
en.developmentSaved: Remote preview ports saved. Changes apply immediately.
en.directoryTruncated: Only part of this directory could be shown.
en.emptyDirectory: This directory has no visible subdirectories.
en.enterAccountPassword: Enter the Server account and password.
en.hostSignInHint: Sign in to authorize this Host on the selected Server.
en.modeSavedNeedsAuthorization: Mode saved. Authorize {role} before connecting. Existing registrations were kept.
en.modeSavedOwnedRole: Mode saved. This owned device was authorized automatically. Restart Harness to apply.
en.modeSavedReused: Mode saved. Existing registration reused. Restart Harness to apply.
en.noAntigravityWorkspaces: No Antigravity workspaces yet. Add a project directory to start.
en.noClaudeWorkspaces: No Claude workspaces yet. Add a project directory to start.
en.noConnectedClients: No devices are currently connected to this Host.
en.noCursorWorkspaces: No Cursor workspaces yet. Add a project directory to start.

en.noOpencodeWorkspaces: No OpenCode workspaces yet. Add a project directory to start.
en.noPiWorkspaces: No Pi workspaces yet. Add a project directory to start.
en.noRemoteHosts: No authorized remote Host for this account.
en.noRemoteWorkspaces: No remote workspaces yet. Use + to add one.
en.passwordHint: Used only for this HTTPS authorization request and never saved.
en.previewLocalOnly: Preview requires Desktop or a browser connected to Harness on this computer.
en.previewPortsHint: Allow specific Host ports (1024–65535), separated by commas. Empty disables preview. HTTP, WebSocket and hot reload are supported.
en.qrLoginExpired: This QR code expired. Refresh it to continue.
en.readOnly: This DSH profile does not provide writable user settings.
en.registrationCodeHint: Generate it after signing in on the Server website. Use it once to connect this device.
en.remoteControlUnavailable: Remote plugin control is still starting. Restart DSH if it stays unavailable.
en.remoteDescription: Choose one of your Hosts, then select a working directory. The Harness interface stays on this device.
en.remotePathHint: Enter an absolute directory path on the selected Host.
en.remoteProgressAuthorizingPeerDetail: Confirming account membership and pinned Host identity.
en.remoteProgressCheckingHostDetail: Finding the selected device and checking whether it is online.
en.remoteProgressLoadingWorkspacesDetail: Reading the remote Harness workspace list through the tunnel.
en.remoteProgressOpeningChannelDetail: Trying LAN, P2P, TURN, then Relay if needed.
en.remoteProgressProbeLanDetail: Checking whether the Host is reachable on the local network.

en.remoteProgressProbeRelayDetail: Preparing the encrypted Server Relay fallback if direct paths do not open.
en.remoteProgressProbeTurnDetail: Checking the TURN relay path for restricted networks.
en.remoteProgressReadyDetail: The remote Host is connected and encrypted.
en.remoteProgressSwitchingWorkspaceDetail: Handing the remote workspace to the local Harness UI.
en.scanLoginHint: Authorize on your phone. This window will continue automatically.
en.selectHostHint: Select an online Host to browse its directories.
en.serverSaved: Server address saved. Restart DSH to apply it.
en.serverUrlHint: HTTPS origin used for account authorization and encrypted relay.
en.signedOut: Signed out and disconnected from Remote.
en.starProject: Star us on GitHub — your support matters to this project
en.terminalRemoteHint: Allow trusted Remote devices to run an interactive shell as this Host user. On by default; independent of Agent approvals. Toggling saves and applies immediately.
en.terminalRemoteUnavailable: Remote terminal is unavailable. Enable Remote terminal in the Host Remote settings; the switch applies immediately.
en.terminalSaved: Remote terminal setting saved. Applies immediately.
